description: Manually reviewed, source-backed potential estimates. These are calibrated ceiling estimates, not exact source-published 0-99 grades.

REG-nhl-draft-2028-gordei-khotkov.rationale: 2010-born 6-foot-5 left-shot defender; 63 points in 56 U16/U17 games and 31 points in 19 Russia Cup games. Scouting describes high-end puck-moving and offensive activation, while noting defensive-awareness and consistency risk.

REG-nhl-draft-2028-kane-cloutier.rationale: 2010-born forward selected first overall in the 2026 OHL Priority Selection; produced 58 points in 33 GTHL games. Scout projection is first-line forward with elite handling and creativity; strength and explosiveness remain development areas.

REG-nhl-draft-2028-isak-alvudd.rationale: 2010-born Swedish forward ranked among the top European players of his age group; scouting reports highlight dynamic speed, high-level puck skill, fast processing and dual-threat offense.

REG-nhl-draft-2028-lionel-dedial.rationale: 2010-born Swiss forward; 20 points in 14 Swiss U21 games and a 10-point international tournament. Reports emphasize an elite release, vision and puck protection; skating pace against adults remains a development question.

NHL-8486052.rationale: NHL Central Scouting No. 8 North American skater; led the OHL with 97 points in 67 games as a rookie and won OHL Rookie of the Year. NHL scouting describes high-end puck skill, hockey IQ, shooting and top-six upside.

NHL-8483478.rationale: Age 22, second-round 2022 pick, two-time NCAA national champion with 35 points in 43 games in 2025-26. Current projection is bottom-six/depth rather than top-six; potential is capped accordingly.

NHL-8475324.rationale: Age 36 veteran with 694 NHL games and a two-year contract through 2027-28. No remaining developmental upside is assumed; potential is set at the current-level baseline.
